rationale: The header cannot be represented by this request IR; pruning it is local to event creation, while idempotency support remains named follow-on engine work.

test.name: idempotency-key
test.description: A unique string to prevent duplicate requests. Each subsequent request matching this unique string will return the same response. We suggest using v4 UUIDs. Keys expire after 24 hours.

provenance.observed: The OpenAPI operation declares an idempotency-key header parameter.
provenance.specd: The current SDK request contract omits this header until first-class idempotency support is added to the engine.
